title: Planner: Planner Plugin lets Copilot Cowork read and update plans and tasks
summary: The briefing passes: the deployment default, licensing, admin paths and API calls are supported by Microsoft documentation, and the rollout details match Microsoft's records. A minor checklist issue remains: the Information Barriers and Planner access reviews have no corresponding controls-table rows.
